description:
Hi,


This is Anthony from Infojini Consulting. Hope you are doing well! 


We are Looking for Sharepoint Developer position based in Raleigh NC for  7 month  contract position. Please send your resume along with hourly rate expectation to anthony(dot)v@infojiniconsulting(dot)com ASAP or call me at 443-270-1551.Please refer someone else if you are not available at this time or you are not the right match for this job opportunity. We have great Referral Bonus up to $1000!!! Please don't miss to refer someone who is looking for projects.




JOB DETAILS GIVEN BELOW:-
Title: Sharepoint Developer
Duration: 7-month contract
Location: Raleigh NC 
Client: Direct client

Complete Description:
Need a programmer to perform various website and intranet maintenance duties and communicating with customers. The programmer will be assisting with light programming duties on departmental Systems and advancing their capabilities. 
Expected Skills: Able to work successfully with guidance. 

Description (including, but not limited to):
1. Development and enhancement of applications based on established design specifications
2. Analysis, design, coding, component/assembly testing of all application code owned by the Application Team
3. Implementing configuration changes to software applications to meet both functional and technical requirements
4. Writing application software, data analysis, data access, data structures, data manipulation, databases, design, programming, testing and implementation, technical and user documentation, software conversions, maintenance (including production support)
5. Unit testing applications and developing system and user documentation


 Required
• An understanding of the concepts of object orientated programming.
• Working knowledge of MS-SQL Server relational databases.
• Experience with C#, Visual Basic.NET, ASP.NET, XML,CSS, Javascript and HTML
• Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships and to communicate effectively in oral and written form with employees in the dept.
• Ability to learn new software systems and programming languages by studying available references.
• Ability to work well with a variety of people.
Desired
• Experience using Team Foundation Server.
Nice to have
• Knowledge and experience with a modern Systems Development Life Cycle (SDLC) methodology such as Scrum or Agile.


 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
